name: What Home Inspectors Flag on Hardwood Floors in Seattle
title-tag: What Home Inspectors Flag on Hardwood Floors in Seattle
meta-description: Cupping, staining, slope, squeaks, worn finish: what each hardwood flag in a Seattle inspection report means, and which ones are worth fixing before listing.
post-summary: November 16, 2026 · Inspectors flag moisture evidence first, structure second, cosmetics last — and in Seattle’s older housing stock each flag has a local translation. What the report language actually means, which flags a refinish genuinely resolves, and what to leave alone in a century-old house.
